_readme: Framing of the radar mob icons (minimap and fullscreen map). Edit a copy in config/sharedjourney/mob_icons/*.json, or ship your own assets/<namespace>/sharedjourney/mob_icons/*.json from a mod or resource pack: files are merged field by field, later ones win. /sj icons reload re-reads them in game, /sj icons dump lists what was detected for every mob.
global.wholeModelScale: extra scale of whole-model icons (a body is much bigger than a head). global.maxFill / minFill: largest and smallest share of the icon cell a mob may span.
models: keyed by model class name, inherited by every mob rendered with that model (and by modded mobs reusing it). entities: keyed by entity type id, overrides the model entry.

Fields: scale (multiplies the natural size, 1 = a block is half a cell), rotX / rotY (degrees, tilt / turn the model), mode (auto | head | whole), headPart (part name or parent/child path of the head when detection fails), offsetX / offsetY (blocks, positive = right / down).
